subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps for Acme Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-commerce.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping: next steps after discovery call

Hi Liam / Priya —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap from discovery:
- Use case: site search & personalized recommendations across desktop + mobile (high QPS).
- SLOs: 95th pct latency < 150ms for autocomplete; batched generation for recommendations ok within 500ms.
- Data: PII-scrubbed product logs + embeddings; retention requirement 6 months.
- Success criteria: 20% reduction in search latency and 10% uplift in add-to-cart rate in a 6-week pilot.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder map — can you share an org chart or list of decision makers (economic buyer, procurement lead, security reviewer)?
2) Procurement process — what are the steps and timelines (PO, SOW, legal redlines, SOC2 evidence)?
3) Pilot scope & timing — we proposed a 6-week pilot. Are there any blockers for starting mid-July?
4) Attachments — I’ve attached a short stakeholder-template to capture owners and approval steps.

If you can loop in Rajiv from procurement and Sameer from security (or point me to the right person), I’ll draft a mutual action plan and a one-page pilot SOW.

Thanks — appreciate quick pointers here so we can lock calendar for the follow-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attached: Redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-commerce.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping: next steps after discovery call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that’s accurate. I’ve attached our org chart and answered the procurement questions in the sheet. High level: 
- Economic buyer: Priya Shah (CFO) — final sign-off on budget and vendor selection.
- Procurement lead: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acme-commerce.com> — handles PO and standard vendor terms.
- Security reviewer: Sameer Patel <sameer.patel@acme-commerce.com> — handles vendor security questionnaires & SOC2 evidence.

Procurement timeline: 2-3 weeks for standard vendors once SOW and T&Cs are agreed; ask Rajiv if there are any enterprise procurement windows but we’re generally flexible.

I’m attaching: Acme-org-chart.png and procurement-questions.xlsx (filled).

Happy to introduce you to Rajiv / Sameer — looping in Priya here to confirm.

Cheers,
Liam
Sr. Product Manager — Search & Personalization
Acme Commerce
